waybackify cache [flags] <wayback-url>

Fetch the capture into a local bucket image

Fetch the capture into a local bucket image at <root> — the #249
mirror's population path. Syncing that dir to R2 / Fastly KV
(rclone/wrangler/fastly tooling) IS deployment.

Output: files written under the shared key scheme; summary line on
stdout.

Arguments:
  <wayback-url>        full web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>/<original> replay URL

Flags:
  --output|-o <root>   cache root directory (the local bucket image) — required
  --no-requisites      store only the named capture; skip its im_/cs_/js_/oe_ page requisites
  --help|-h            Show help

issues: #254 (parent) · #248 (audit) · #249 (mirror)
